selection: Pinned original src C/H/Makefile, all ten original BMP assets and README. Original docs/report and unused Minix service configuration are omitted. Original artwork remains unchanged.
controlsRationale: Original S release starts; Space release jumps. The runner scrolls automatically. A reserved control panel exposes Start and Jump in both orientations. Physical mouse input is available on desktop; mobile pointer is off because its original menu also accepts a keyboard start and gameplay is keyboard-driven. Escape exits the original menu; collection Home ends an active run. Both authored absolute and relative home paths explicitly map to the pinned asset root.

files.reason: Return zero explicitly when the original pipe-collision predicate is false, avoiding an undefined return that ends a safe running or airborne game.
files.verification: Actual optimized owning function called through a volatile function pointer originally reports collision for a distant pipe; corrected distant/airborne/touching-edge positions return0 and the original overlapping ground position returns1.

files.reason: Implement the declared void cleanup by calling the existing timer, keyboard and mouse unsubscribe owners; remove the discarded allocation and invalid value return.
files.verification: Original void function returning a pointer fails return-type diagnostics; corrected actual cleanup calls all three original owners exactly once in order.

files.reason: Pass the caller long buffer to sys_inb and return the loaded RTC byte rather than passing the address of a local pointer and returning that pointer.
files.verification: Actual readDate owning fixture checks unchanged caller guards and exactyear/seconds bytes; original invalid pointer ABI is RED and corrected caller-buffer read GREEN.

files.reason: Initialize the four VBE2 signature bytes with character constants rather than string-literal pointers.
files.verification: Actual original mode-information unit fails compilation on four pointer-to-byte assignments; corrected owning test compiles and receives exact1024x768x16 BIOS information.

verification.browser: Normal CDP touch Start/Jump, running animation, airborne jump and first pipe passed with current opaque-IRQ SDK. No page errors; landscape and portrait verified separately. Separate fresh ordinary runs verify natural collision -> original Game Over/date/score print -> Game finished, and original Escape menu exit -> Game finished. No page errors.
verification.native: All16 actual Makefile translation units compile to ARM64 objects with NDK27 -O2 -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=2 -fstack-protector-strong and format-security. Actual Android gameplay pending.

nativeGameplay.demonstrated: Root viewed original menu, Start, ordinary Jump release with Mario visibly airborne, landing and advancing pipe/scenery, then clean Home return.
limitations: Representative run and jump verified on Android. First pipe pass and natural collision date/score separately verified in browser; no native first-pipe or full-score claim.

artwork.icon: Original mario.bmp and pipe.bmp sprites, nearest-neighbor scaling on a simple dark tile; cyan sprite backgrounds removed only in this derived icon. Original BMP assets unchanged.
artwork.preview: Actual1024x768 gameplay canvas during an ordinary Jump action, scaled to640x480.
